title: Upgrade the personal website to React
request: Migrate the existing WebeWizard website to React, preserving its current content, visual design, navigation, and accessibility. Add a reproducible local development and production build, update tests and documentation, and adapt the existing GitHub Pages workflow to publish only the built website. Do not add personal facts, analytics, external runtime assets, paid services, or unrelated features. Implementation, merge, publication, and deployment require the applicable city decisions.
acceptanceCriteria: The About page is rendered using React and retains the WebeWizard heading, supplied bio I am a wizard, existing visual design, semantic landmarks, skip link, and anchor navigation.
At 320px and desktop widths the website has no horizontal overflow; keyboard focus, WCAG AA text contrast, and reduced-motion support remain functional.

Documented commands reproducibly install locked dependencies, run the React development server, build production assets, and pass updated checks that validate the React-rendered page and built asset resolution beneath /webe-website/.
The GitHub Pages workflow builds and checks the React website before uploading only production output; existing main-only guards and least-privilege deployment permissions are preserved.

Delivery stays within site and .github/workflows, with separate city administrative records; independent inspection and resident acceptance precede merge or release, and no deployment or publication occurs without explicit resident authorization.
